latest_events.summary: Since August, there has been significant fighting between the jihadists of Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda, and their rivals the Islamic State in the Sahel (ISIS). These fights are taking place on the border between Mali and Burkina Faso, also not far from the Nigerian border. The last clashes took place at the end of last week, mainly on Friday, October 9 in Gonadaouri, in the Burkinabe province of Oudalan .

latest_events.title: Last minute: The FAMa thwart an attack in Kidal
latest_events.summary: As part of Operation Dougoukolo, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are stepping up their fight to secure the national territory. On Friday, October 9, 2026, their vigilance and responsiveness made it possible to thwart a threat of attack against an army convoy in the Kidal region . It was southwest of the city of Kidal that the worst was averted.

latest_events.title: Mali: In Kidal, soldiers outnumber locals
latest_events.summary: Mali: in Kidal, the soldiers outnumber the inhabitants Three days after their return to Kidal, the Malian soldiers and their Russian partners of the Africa Corps secure the city and its surroundings. The army conducts daily airstrikes in the area but has not yet continued its ground advance The separatists of the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla) and the jihadists of the Support Group for Islam and Muslims (Jnim), linked to al-Qaeda, were forced to withdraw before the arrival of the army in Kidal.
